title: W-BSDEs with Common Noise: Well-posedness, Characterization, and Consequences
summary: We study a notion of backward stochastic differential equation on the Wasserstein space, called a W-BSDE. This work extends to the common noise setting recent results of the first author. The equation is formulated in Markovian form along admissible flows of conditional laws generated by McKean-Vlasov dynamics with common noise. A solution is a pair of fields $(Y,Z)$, where $Y$ is a functional on the space of probability measures and $Z$ is the corresponding intrinsic Wasserstein gradient.
